value.rationale: Sharp type-I error calibration for the commonly used but potentially invalid fixed-reference plus-one test directly answers which biased two-transform sampling probabilities are defensible at each computational budget. The exact cycle structural invariant determines a full universal finite-sample frontier; the M=1 to M=2 reversal is mathematically and practically consequential. Corrected random-reference tests remain available for unconstrained samplers.
